acceptanceCriteria: A spec section with numbered requirements defines the converter, its closed producer-only member list (confirmed by the wire owner) and the provenance member; the wire owner reviews the converter against the frozen V1-1265 shape.
Running the converter twice over every committed .corvint/changes/*.cem.json yields byte-identical output; fixtures cover a reachable bind, an unavailable-object map, f0fda542 and a 0.1/0.3 input.

For every committed map, the native consumer and interop/cem01-go report the same verdict for the converted map as for its 0.x source, except where a section 4 empty member explains the difference; the comparison is retained as evidence.
body: Source: decision 0525 (docs/decisions/0525-cem-1-0-only-rc3-2026-10-11.md, PR beamfall/corvint#819), owner instruction 2026-10-11 that rc.3 ships cem/1.0 as the only CEM. Owner lane: orchestrating session; the CEM 1.0 vision session owns the wire (V1-1262/1273/1263/1264/1265/1266). Implement the decision 0525 section 4 converter against the shape frozen by V1-1265. It is a pure function of the 0.x map bytes and the Git objects they pin; it never changes a verdict (hunk disposition, bases and evidence carry over; tiers stay consumer-computed). Producer-only members (criteria, receipts, artifacts, authentication, intent and scope, structural witnesses) are emitted empty, never synthesized. Every output carries the provenance member (source spec, source blob OID and SHA-256, bind commit, converter version). Maps whose pinned objects are unavailable (three beamfall-dogfood receipt maps; any of the 35 bind commits unreachable from origin/main) and maps that fail verification before conversion (f0fda542, git-budget-exceeded) still convert from bytes and must verify to the same explicit unavailable/abstaining/pre-existing result. The converter spec lists the producer-only members for the wire owner to confirm before V1-1265 freezes. The converter is removed with the rest of 0.x (decision 0525 section 5).
title: cem/1.0 decision 0525 step 4: deterministic cem/0.x -> cem/1.0 map converter with provenance member
